title: Say Why
transcription:
Say Why

Say Why, should this parting make us cry?
Say Why, should this parting make us cry?
Say Why, should this parting make us cry?
Say why, dear friend, say why.

Say Who, could I ever love but you?
Say Who, could I ever love but you?
Say Who, could I ever love but you?
Say who, dear friend, say who.

Say When, shall we ever meet again?
Say When, shall we ever meet again?
Say When, shall we ever meet again?
Say when, dear friend, say when.

Say Where, and I will meet you there.
Say Where, and I will meet you there.
Say Where, and I will meet you there.
Say where, dear friend, say where.

Say Why, Say Who, Say When,
Say Where.
